notices.correlation: The six models read the same 85 inputs and behave like about 1.2 independent models. Agreement among them is not six independent confirmations.
notices.experimental: Drive simulation and lineup analysis are experimental research outputs, not official forecasts.
notices.market: Sportsbook prices are a benchmark. A model-versus-market difference is not a proven betting edge; historically the closing market has been more accurate than the champion.
notices.challengers: Challengers are tracked prospectively and are not promoted until they meet a pre-registered standard over 128+ games.

historical.note: Historical walk-forward results; these seasons were examined during research, so they are not untouched holdouts.

prospective.note: Genuinely prospective: immutable pregame archives scored after the game.
